lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Do you have the fourteen inch ThinkPad in stock?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes, we have it in silver and black, with sixteen gigabytes of memory. It comes with a two year warranty.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Great. Until what time are you open today?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: We're open until seven this evening. Shall I keep one aside for you under your name?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes please, the black one. Ramesh.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Done, Ramesh. The black one is waiting for you at the counter until seven.
